name: bld6_lcm_mul_integral_central_beta_nat
informal: Uses Mathlib2.calc_integral_beta_nat and Mathlib2.arith_centralBinom_dvd_lcm: by mul_pow and calc_integral_beta_nat n n the integral is (n!)^2/(2n+1)! = 1/((2n+1)·centralBinom n) (Nat.centralBinom, Nat.choose factorial formula); so the left side equals lcm(1..2n)/centralBinom n, which is a positive natural number q by arith_centralBinom_dvd_lcm (Nair's integrality argument made explicit).
